items.q: How often should I use ELARA Regenerative Barrier Serum?
items.a: For optimal results, apply 2 to 3 drops daily in both your morning and evening rituals after cleansing.

items.q: Is ELARA suitable for sensitive or climate-stressed skin?
items.a: Yes. ELARA is explicitly formulated for skin exposed to heat, air conditioning, and urban stressors, tested for optimal skin compatibility.

items.q: Can ELARA be layered with other skincare products?
items.a: Absolutely. Its lightweight fluid texture absorbs rapidly, making it ideal under moisturizers, sunscreen, or makeup.

items.q: What makes ELARA different from conventional serums?
items.a: ELARA focuses on cellular harmony rather than high-percentage harsh actives, repairing the barrier while boosting natural resilience.
